scope: Seven static portable identities. No new gameplay, spawns, animation, import or live acceptance claim.

frames.description: One dry knuckled ochre shell with a few short bent hooks and an irregular dry edge.
frames.realSource: Actual StoneburrPatch harvest produces this portable reagent; source disappears when spent.
frames.actualUse: Reagent binding:2 participates in existing brewing, including stoneskin tonic.
frames.limits: No SeedPart: the name does not make this plantable. No seed packet, plant stem, face or quantity promise.

frames.description: A small low detached crust with blunt sage frond edges and muted cold flecks.
frames.realSource: Harvested from a real FrostLichenPatch; detached portion is smaller than the living broad crust.
frames.actualUse: Reagent cold:2 participates in the existing brewing rules.
frames.limits: No crystal points, snowflake, stars, light, snow aura, rooted plant or wider source-patch silhouette.

frames.description: A detached short forked stem with two broad olive leaves and one quiet vein on each.
frames.realSource: Real MendleafPlant harvest yields the raw sprig.
frames.actualUse: Reagent vital:1; two carried sprigs can be prepared near a still into one ConcentratedMendleaf.
frames.limits: Not a rooted three-leaf plant, ready healing potion, bandage, full branch or extra medicinal effect.

frames.description: A compact rusty-red double-lobed fruit cluster with a tiny attached dry stem.
frames.realSource: Finite BerryBush harvest yields one to three units; the art does not encode the stack quantity.
frames.actualUse: Raw FoodPart heals1d3 when a real carried unit is eaten.
frames.limits: Cooking=Meal is flavor, not a Cookable part. No basket, planted bush, growing leaf canopy or cooked food.

frames.description: One small rounded muted-gold disk with a single square dark inset and a worn pale edge.
frames.realSource: Existing loose currency, including actual hollow-stump output; no new money spawn.
frames.actualUse: Existing Commerce currency; value and quantity remain owned game state.
frames.limits: No coin stack, sack, amount text, cross emblem, glow, gem facet or repeated sparkles.

frames.description: An opaque broad-based grey-green flask with a short neck and a plain brown stopper.
frames.realSource: The one existing brew blueprint carries varied resolved payloads; actual north-worksite stoneskin batch was observed.
frames.actualUse: Consumed through TonicPart; healing-only uses Healing dice, status/coating/throwable outcomes may own BrewItemPart.
frames.limits: One neutral container for supported forms, never a promise of healing or safe drinking. Explicit Food, foreign or unknown form stays runtime fallback; no liquid line, label, reusable empty vessel or payload symbol.

frames.description: A compact dry pressed olive leaf wad, with one folded seam and a pale cut edge.
frames.realSource: Prepare consumes two actual MendleafSprig units near a still to produce one portable measure.
frames.actualUse: Reagent vital:2; brewing can make one2d4 mending tonic instead of separate1d4 sprig brews.
frames.limits: Still raw reagent, not a ready potion, bandage, medicine bottle, tied package or loose full-size sprig.
